odteste.comando.elemento.escondido: %s's element: %s (hidden: the player does not know yet).
odteste.comando.elemento.erro.sem: %s has no element to reveal. Set one first: /odteste elemento <player> <element>.
odteste.elemento.revelado: Something inside you answers by name. It was always %s.
odteste.comando.erro.elemento: Unknown element: %s. Use nenhum, sangue, conhecimento, morte or energia.
odteste.comando.erro.estagio: Missing the Mark stage for %s (1 to 4). Only "nenhum" can skip the stage.
odteste.momento.marca.morte: Time slowed down on your skin.
odteste.horror.exposicao.comum.1: Nothing has looked at you. Yet.
odteste.horror.exposicao.comum.3: You are still just one of many.
odteste.horror.exposicao.baixa.1: You heard something. It heard you.
odteste.horror.exposicao.media.1: There are footsteps that match yours.
odteste.horror.exposicao.alta.1: Someone stands at the edge of your sight. They are still there.
odteste.horror.exposicao.alta.3: What looks back already knows your name.
odteste.horror.exposicao.critica.1: You are no longer the one searching.
odteste.horror.exposicao.critica.2: The door is open. On the other side, they are waiting.
odteste.horror.lucidez.firme.1: Feet on the ground. For now.
odteste.horror.lucidez.firme.2: What you see is what exists.
odteste.horror.lucidez.firme.3: Breathe. Everything is in its place.
odteste.horror.lucidez.alta.1: Something is out of place. You haven't found it yet.
odteste.horror.lucidez.media.1: You no longer trust what you hear.
odteste.horror.lucidez.media.2: The door you closed is open.
odteste.horror.lucidez.baixa.1: Your own voice whispers from across the room.
odteste.horror.lucidez.baixa.2: You no longer know who is calling you.
odteste.horror.lucidez.baixa.3: What is real drifts away from you.
odteste.horror.lucidez.surto.2: There is no floor. Only what you think is there.
odteste.horror.lucidez.surto.3: You are lost and cannot find the way.
odteste.configuration.title: Od Teste
odteste.configuration.efeitos_fortes.too: Camera shake, tilt and visual hallucinations (figures, doors, blocks). SUAVE halves it; DESLIGADO leaves only vignette, sound and text.
item.odteste.rubra.objeto: A kitchen knife that grew. Its edge grew teeth.
item.odteste.rubra.poder: Wounded, it bites: every blow opens blood that builds up.
item.odteste.rubra.custo: It only wakes when your own blood is already running.
odteste.rubra.ferida: The jaw closes. The wound opens.
item.odteste.agulha_de_cerzir_carne.obje: A crochet needle wrapped in red thread. The thread never runs out.
item.odteste.agulha_de_cerzir_carne.pode: Closes wounds and stops the bleeding.
item.odteste.agulha_de_cerzir_carne.cust: Every stitch in the flesh is owed to the paranormal.
odteste.artefato.agulha.uso: The thread goes in and out. The flesh obeys.
item.odteste.dedal_dentado.objeto: A dark iron thimble. Inside, teeth.
item.odteste.dedal_dentado.poder: For a while, whoever wounds you bleeds too.
item.odteste.dedal_dentado.custo: It bites your mind and takes some of your breath until you sleep.
odteste.artefato.dedal.uso: The teeth close on your finger. Now they wait.
item.odteste.sino_de_matadouro.objeto: A butcher's brass bell. The clapper is black with dried blood. It rings without wind.
item.odteste.sino_de_matadouro.poder: Its toll enrages those at your side.
item.odteste.sino_de_matadouro.custo: It charges flesh from whoever rings it. And the paranormal listens.
odteste.artefato.sino.uso: The bell tolls. Something far away heard it too.
odteste.artefato.sino.sem_sangue: The bell is heavy. There is not enough blood to pay for the toll.
odteste.artefato.recusa.recarga: Not yet. It does not answer.
odteste.artefato.recusa.compartilhada: Your hands still shake from the last one.
odteste.artefato.recusa.sem_lucidez: Your mind cannot hold this right now.
item.odteste.materia_sangue_bruta.objeto: Thick, heavy and warm. It smells of rust and meat.
ritual.odteste.chamado_de_sangue.started: The chalk drinks the blood. Something heard.
ritual.odteste.chamado_de_sangue.conditi: The call does not take hold here.
odteste.ato1.abertura: %s. You heard the bell and came in. It was before. You only forgot.
odteste.ato1.troca.1: It is not hunger. It is a call.
odteste.ato1.troca.2: The bell has not finished counting.
odteste.ato1.troca.3: He slept there. Now he does not sleep.
odteste.ato1.livro_carniceiro.1.pagina1:
Five steps at a time.

Whoever counts in a hurry loses the way. The bell teaches you to listen. The rest, the flesh teaches.
odteste.ato1.livro_carniceiro.1.pagina2: (On the back, a circle scratched in charcoal. They never finished drawing it.)
odteste.ato1.mapa_esquerda.descricao: A cartographer's map, cut in half.
odteste.ato1.admin.enigma_sino: %s solved the Village Bell. The chest opened.
odteste.evento.primeiro_sinal.ok: First Sign released for %s. Bell at %s %s %s. Banner: %s. Villager vanished: %s.
odteste.evento.desfazer.ok: Undone for %s. Blocks a player had already changed (left as they are): %s. Villager came back: %s.
odteste.evento.erro.sem_grupo: There is no group %s. Create it with /odteste grupo criar.
odteste.evento.erro.ja_marcada: Group %s already has a marked village. Use /odteste evento desfazer %1$s first.
odteste.evento.erro.dimensao: The saved dimension no longer exists.
odteste.evento.erro.ninguem_online: Nobody from group %s is online. Give a point: /odteste evento primeiro_sinal %1$s <x y z>.
odteste.evento.erro.sem_vila: No free village bell near %s %s %s (loaded chunks without claims only).
odteste.evento.erro.sem_espaco: No free space near the bell at %s %s %s for the note block, chest and sign. Nothing was touched.
odteste.evento.erro.nada_para_desfazer: Group %s has no event to undo.
odteste.evento.erro.descarregado: Chunk not loaded at %s %s %s. Go there and try again (undo never loads chunks).
odteste.evento.erro.aldeao_nao_voltou: The villager of group %s could not come back (near %s %s %s; see the log). Nothing was undone: the village and the saved villager stay. Clear the spot and try again.
odteste.evento.retrancado: Puzzle 1 of group %s locked again: blank unwaxed sign, locked and empty chest. Story pieces removed from the chest: %s.
odteste.historia.itens_soltos: %s stack(s) of player items were in our chests and were dropped on the ground (first at %s %s %s).
odteste.grupo.erro.nome: Invalid name: %s (lowercase letters, numbers and _, up to 24).
odteste.grupo.erro.tem_evento: Group %s has an active event. Undo it before deleting.
odteste.estrutura.prever.cabe: %s fits here (%s blocks). You can now use colocar with the same point.
odteste.estrutura.prever.nao_cabe: %s does not fit here: blocked at %s %s %s (%s). Nothing will be placed at this point.
odteste.estrutura.sugestao: Suggested point: %s %s %s. Check it with /odteste estrutura prever %s %s %s %s %s before placing.
odteste.estrutura.sem_sugestao: No free point found nearby (up to %s blocks). Choose another place.
odteste.estrutura.erro.prever_antes: Run /odteste estrutura prever with the same template, point and rotation first (valid for 5 minutes).
odteste.estrutura.erro.sem_lugar: %s no longer fits at the point (the world changed since prever): blocked at %s %s %s (%s). Nothing was placed.
odteste.estrutura.desfeita: Placement %s undone. Blocks a player had already changed (left as they are): %s.
odteste.estrutura.erro.interno: An error happened in the middle of placing %s (see the log). What went in was recorded: use /odteste estrutura desfazer %s.
odteste.estrutura.prever.grande: Large: the ground is fine. On colocar, the space is checked in %s parts and only then the structure goes in, one part per tick (~%s s in total). Chunks must be loaded.
odteste.estrutura.partes.comecou: Checking the space for %s in %s parts (id %s); if it fits, the structure goes in right after. Progress shows in chat. To cancel and remove everything: /odteste estrutura desfazer %s
odteste.estrutura.partes.continua: Structure %s continues (the next part checks the space again).
odteste.estrutura.partes.desfazendo_inic: Undoing %s in parts (%s blocks). Progress shows in chat.
odteste.estrutura.partes.conferido: Structure %s: space checked, placing in %s parts.
odteste.estrutura.partes.nao_cabe: Structure %s (%s) does not fit: blocked at %s %s %s (%s). Nothing was placed; choose another point and use prever again.
odteste.estrutura.partes.pronta: Structure %s (%s) done: %s blocks. To remove it: /odteste estrutura desfazer %s
odteste.estrutura.partes.sem_dimensao: Structure %s: the dimension does not exist, undo stopped.
odteste.estrutura.partes.desfeita: Structure %s undone. Blocks kept (a player changed them): %s.
odteste.estrutura.partes.soltos: Player items dropped on the ground: %s (near %s).
odteste.estrutura.partes.esperando: Structure %s: waiting for the chunk at %s %s %s to load (stay close). It continues on its own.
odteste.estrutura.partes.pausada: Structure %s paused at part %s/%s: %s. Use /odteste estrutura continuar %s or desfazer %s.
